hypothesis: At a real pregame decision, verified KBO lineup and prior bullpen availability adds out-of-sample predictive information beyond the same-time full-game market and no-fact baseline.
unit: one unique KBO game and full-game win/draw/loss product with identical line, odds, decision time and settlement for all arms; preserve void/refund rules
eligibility: Real decision <= scheduled kickoff minus 30 minutes; all used receipts <= decision, with timezone-aware times
Official confirmed starters and nine-player batting orders with player IDs and handedness; probable or inferred is not confirmed

Venue ID, official prior completed game boxscores and relief-pitch appearances and pitch counts, actual receipt timestamps, and complete 48h coverage; 24h and 48h intervals are [decision-24h, decision) and [decision-48h, decision), keyed by prior game end time

Both teams, unique official-to-market game and player crosswalk, complete contemporaneous odds vector, recorded exact frozen operating decision including abstentions, and official settled result with receipt time
Retain source response bytes, URLs, SHA-256, provenance and receipt evidence; digest proves byte consistency only

Exclude missing or conflicting IDs, late receipts, postponed or revised kickoff ambiguity, incomplete workload coverage, unknown counts, uncertain confirmation, and duplicate or conflicting documents; retain explicit reason and full opportunity denominator
features: pre-decision confirmed starting pitcher identities and lineup changes when prior snapshot exists; unknown change remains missing
team relief workload over 24 and 48 hours and time since last relief appearance, computed from previous completed games available by decision; exclude target game
venue and confirmed lineup handedness counts with provenance; missing handedness is not imputed as zero
model: Single candidate: regularized logistic residual against normalized same-time market home probability, using only predeclared numeric feature differences, one-hot venue and starter/lineup identity representations with shrinkage; no manual probability bonuses. Draw treated as refund for two-way win/loss when contract requires, excluded from binary proper-score calculation and explicitly reported; three-way treated separately, no pooling.
baseline: same market, exact recorded current frozen operating selection including abstentions, and predeclared market-offset model without fact features. Frozen operating probability is not a reconstructed 9:1 probability; abstentions do not receive replacement picks.
split: Chronological non-overlapping train, validation, prospective holdout; cutoff dates and data manifest committed before opening holdout labels. Training and validation labels must be actually received strictly before each fit or selection. No refit using holdout labels. One fixed regularization grid [0.1, 1, 10, 100] selected by validation log loss, tie strongest regularization.
stop: No fitting until >=200 eligible training games, >=50 validation games, >=100 genuinely new holdout games, and >=80% complete factual coverage of audited opportunity set within each split. Otherwise blocked_data. These are feasibility thresholds, not statistical power guarantees. Freeze data, cutoffs, code and candidate before holdout access. Stop for leakage, source or identity ambiguity; never tune on holdout.
analysis: Report opportunities and each exclusion, complete-case coverage and coverage by arm, picks and abstentions; identical-game identical-price comparisons, accuracy, 1-unit ROI with declared refunds, binary log loss, Brier, chronological daily closing maximum drawdown; no metrics where undefined. Report uncertainty using game-date block bootstrap, seed fixed before evaluation. No automatic promotion. Check selection bias and quantify unavailable frozen operating decisions separately.
checks: Python tests on actual input and synthetic boundary fixtures for receipt <= decision <= T-30 and past-game final receipt
replace all current/future game labels and assert candidate features and predictions unchanged
deduplicate only byte-identical verified documents with same game and fact/revision; distinguish reused document from independent reports
reject unverified or missing bytes, ambiguous identity, future and target-game workload, incomplete odds and unknown relief coverage
